title: M3.1 Pedagogical Quality promotion rebind verifier
purpose: Verify promotion of the frozen human-approved and independently-QA-passed M3.1 pedagogical-quality product onto current main without mutating product semantics or historical product/QA workflows.
invariants: No frozen ATLAS-WP-012 product file is modified by OPS-WP-015.
The verifier runs only for the dedicated M3.1 promotion branch or explicit manual dispatch.
Promotion must change exactly the eleven ATLAS-WP-012 product paths relative to its PR base.
All eleven promoted product files must be byte-identical to frozenProductHead.
The exact independent QA oracle from frozenQaHead must pass in a separate worktree.
The QA diff relative to frozenProductHead must remain exactly the three QA-WP-021 paths.
Canonical validators and M3.1 product/browser tests must pass on the integrated promotion tree.
Generated Pages bundle must be deterministic and contain the exact pedagogical-quality Python authority.
Promoted learner artifact identity must remain unchanged.
Human PASS is already present; UX debt #272 is non-blocking and must not be folded into promotion.
requiredEvidence: Byte identity of all eleven product files to frozenProductHead.
Independent QA-WP-021 oracle PASS from exact frozenQaHead.
Learner artifact exact bytes and SHA-256 PASS.
Machine-readable evidence bound to base, frozen product, frozen QA and promotion head.
adversarialTests: Any promotion path outside the exact eleven-file set.
Any frozen product blob differs by one byte.
QA head not descendant of frozen product head or QA diff not exactly three owned paths.
Pages bundle drift or quality-engine bundle mismatch.
Attempt to implement UX debt #272 during promotion.
independentReview: Repository governance and PR scope must pass for OPS-WP-015.
The promotion verifier must run on the final M3.1 promotion HEAD before merge.
rollback: Remove the verifier workflow in a later governed cleanup after M3.1 promotion closeout.
